citations.quote: Stiftung Wohnen Zentral's termination letter reached me a week ago: they are ending the lease of my 3-room flat at Allmendstrasse 120 in Muttenz with effect from 30 April 2027.
The stated reason is rent arrears. I owe CHF 4320, two months' rent, because my unemployment benefit was delayed.
I believe the arrears are only a pretext. In August I wrote to the Stiftung, with a copy to the conciliation authority, demanding that they repair the leaking windows and reduce my rent until then.
I want to ask for an extension of the tenancy.

Arrears are reported; the cure period, claimed amount and warning need verification.
Needed to establish amounts due, payments and any outstanding balance.
The reported repair and rent-reduction demands are relevant to the retaliation screen.

questions: On what exact date did the termination notice reach you, and do you have the envelope or delivery record? Please provide these and the complete notice urgently so the challenge deadline can be assessed.
Did you receive a prior written payment deadline and termination warning? If so, when?
Are you married or in a registered partnership, and is the flat your shared home? If so, did your spouse or partner receive a separate notice?
